prose: Nexus-CLI is a pure-Go command-line tool and local API proxy that connects any app or coding agent to DeepSeek V3 and R1 through a free chat.deepseek.com web account, no paid API key required, rewritten from scratch with zero runtime dependencies after analyzing earlier Node.js and Python bridges. It offers three account-linking paths (manual token, an automated Chrome login capture, or a .env file), an interactive REPL that streams R1's reasoning, one-shot prompts, Unix-pipe code analysis, and a local server on port 9655 that speaks both the OpenAI chat-completions format and the Ollama API, so Cursor, Claude Code, Open WebUI, Dify, and LlamaIndex can point at DeepSeek as if it were local.
highlights: Free DeepSeek V3/R1 access through a web account, no paid API key
Pure Go rewrite with zero runtime dependencies
Three auth paths: token paste, Chrome capture, .env
Local proxy speaks OpenAI and Ollama API formats on port 9655
Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Open WebUI, Dify, LlamaIndex
REPL streams R1's thinking in real time
